pages.html:
What is a CAPTCHA?

A CAPTCHA ("Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart") asks you to verify you are human. reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha and Cloudflare Turnstile are popular. You may see "I'm not a robot" or be asked to select all images with traffic lights.
